description:
[read-only] The brand's new-advertiser offers per ad network, one row per ad account (or a network not connected yet): status, spend so far, what is left to spend, the daily pace and the deadline, and how to claim. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/offers.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key is pinned to its brand and any other value is 403.

name: ads_offers_list
title: List ad platform offers
